recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future detailed async-pattern changes should be handled under their specific Jira issues and, when the detail is outside core, in the API Incubator, Bulk Data IG, or FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-13922 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core STU3 change request to add asynchronous access pattern support to the base FHIR API and consider what CapabilityStatement should say about it; the resolution said the then-external Bulk Data specification would be integrated into FHIR and maintained through the usual process.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly naming FHIR-13922 was found. The apparent initial application is aa08450fd95f3590fa11c94cc74f2e1a5d9b4a2b, which created source/async.html and moved bulk-data asynchronous API material out of source/http.html.
additional_context: FHIR-35936 later split and aligned async.html with community Bulk Data work; FHIR-24882, FHIR-47271, and FHIR-41202 refined asynchronous interactions, pattern disambiguation, and operation/CapabilityStatement conformance hooks. Those related issues are already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-I 2019 WGM minutes also record that the group did not want a one-off async export discovery protocol in CapabilityStatement.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source/async.html page covers the asynchronous request-pattern landing page and current conformance hooks, while source/http.html links to it and documents the respond-async/Content-Location HTTP surface.
